events.title: Christmas Wreath Workshop — The Lenches Club
events.body: Amulet Blooms is running a Christmas wreath workshop at The Lenches Club on Friday 11 December at 7pm, using fresh and dried materials from its flower farm. It costs £45 per person, including a glass of fizz and a mince pie. Book at amuletblooms.co.uk. Returning customers get 10% off and can email info@amuletblooms.co.uk if they haven't had their discount link.

image.alt: Poster for the Amulet Blooms Christmas wreath workshop showing a wreath of fir, pine cones and dried flowers

events.title: Carols with Avonbank Brass Band — The Lenches Club
events.body: Avonbank Brass Band returns to The Lenches Club on Monday 21 December at 7pm to play Christmas carols, with song sheets for anyone who wants to sing along. Entry is free and includes a mince pie and a small mulled wine on arrival. Donations to the band are welcome.

image.alt: Poster for an evening of carols with Avonbank Brass Band at The Lenches Club, with Father Christmas and candles

events.title: Christmas Prize Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Festive prize bingo for all the family at The Lenches Club on Wednesday 23 December. Tickets go on sale at 7.15pm and eyes down is at 8pm. There are prizes on the book and flyer, and a cash flyer for over-18s at the end of the evening.

notices.title: Road closure — Atch Lench Road, Church Lench
notices.body: Atch Lench Road in Church Lench will be closed between Atch Lench Road and Leys Road from Monday 1 December to Tuesday 9 December for Openreach works. A diversion will be signed. Allow extra time for journeys between the Lenches and Harvington.

notices.title: Roadworks — Leys Road, Harvington
notices.body: Severn Trent Water is working on Leys Road in Harvington from Monday 30 November to Wednesday 2 December. Traffic will be managed by give and take, and delays are possible.

notices.title: Roadworks — Kings Lane, Norton
notices.body: Severn Trent Water is working on Kings Lane in Norton on Thursday 26 November. Two-way temporary signals will be in place, and delays are possible.

notices.title: Neighbourhood Watch: winter burglary and scam advice
notices.body: Neighbourhood Watch says burglaries tend to rise as the evenings draw in, and asks residents to look out for vulnerable neighbours. With more Christmas parcels arriving, have deliveries left somewhere hidden, with a neighbour or at a collection point rather than on the doorstep.

notices.title: Openreach works — Alcester Road, Radford
notices.body: Openreach is carrying out works on Alcester Road, Radford, on Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November. They won't take up any of the road, so delays are unlikely.

notices.title: Road closure — Ab Lench Road, Ab Lench
notices.body: Ab Lench Road will be closed from Monday 16 to Friday 20 November while Worcestershire County Council repairs a damaged section of carrier pipe outside Easter House. A diversion will run between Rous Lench and Ab Lench, and delays are likely.

notices.title: Road closure — Abbots Morton Road, Abbots Morton
notices.body: Abbots Morton Road will be closed for carriageway patching and resurfacing on 3 days between Monday 16 and Tuesday 24 November, ahead of surface dressing by Worcestershire County Council. A diversion will use Alcester Road, and delays are likely.

notices.title: Roadworks — Rectory Close, Harvington
notices.body: Openreach plans works in Rectory Close, Harvington, on Thursday 12 November. A temporary obstruction may cause delays of up to 15 minutes.

notices.title: Christmas hamper bingo callers card — The Lenches Club
notices.body: The Lenches Club is running a callers card draw for a 22-inch luxury wicker Christmas hamper with wine, savoury treats, chocolates, Christmas pudding and festive favourites. Numbers 1 to 90 are £5 each and can be bought from behind the bar by cash or card. The winning number is drawn on Christmas Day.

image.alt: Poster for the Christmas hamper bingo callers card at The Lenches Club: numbers 1 to 90, £5 a number, drawn on Christmas Day

notices.title: The Lenches Club closed 23–25 November
notices.body: The Lenches Club will be closed from Monday 23 to Wednesday 25 November while a new Heineken SmartDispense beer system is installed and the floor behind the bar is repaired. Normal opening hours return on Thursday 26 November. Anyone with a booking on those days will be contacted, and questions can go to Leanne or any committee member.

notices.title: Road Closure — Badgers Hill, Sheriffs Lench
notices.body: Badgers Hill to Handgate Lane will be closed from Tuesday 27 October to Sunday 29 November for Severn Trent Water streetworks, with a diversion via Handgate Lane, Church Lench.
